name: NemynAI – AI Content Writer & Autoblog: Auto-Post SEO Articles
author: NemynAI

sections.description:
NemynAI is an AI content writer and autoblog for WordPress. It writes complete, SEO-optimized articles and publishes them for you — manually or fully on autopilot. You can start with 15 free AI-generated articles right after activation, with no API key and no sign-up.

When you run out of free articles, add your own API key from any of 10 AI providers and keep generating for the cost of your own usage. There is no connect wall: every page works the moment you activate the plugin.

Choose your AI provider (new in 2.2.0)

Pick the provider you already have an account with — or one with a free tier — right in Settings. Each shows a masked key field, a model picker (defaulting to an inexpensive current model), a one-click Test connection button, and a direct Get API key link:

  • Anthropic Claude
  • OpenAI
  • Google Gemini — free tier available
  • Mistral — free tier available
  • DeepSeek
  • xAI Grok
  • Groq — free tier available
  • OpenRouter — free tier available
  • Cohere — free tier available
  • Ollama — runs locally on your own server, no API key and no cloud at all

Source priority is simple: if the selected provider has your key (or a local Ollama Base URL), generation goes through it; otherwise the 15 free NemynAI articles are used.

What you get for free

Everything below works in the free version — no license, no upsell gate:

  • 15 free articles with no API key — generated through the NemynAI service right after activation
  • 10 AI providers to choose from — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI Grok, Groq, OpenRouter, Cohere, or a local Ollama server
  • Unlimited AI writing with your own key — add an API key from any supported provider for unlimited generation
  • Autoblog / scheduled auto-posting — publish daily or twice-weekly at 09:00 via WP Cron
  • CSV content-plan import — upload a month of topics and let the plugin publish them
  • Batch publishing — generate and publish 1, 2, 3, or all queued items at once
  • “Publish Now” from the queue
  • SEO meta written into Yoast SEO, RankMath, or AIOSEO (with a built-in fallback)
  • Open Graph & Twitter Card meta tags
  • Automatic tags added to every article
  • Automatic photos from Pexels (optional — add a free Pexels key for images)
  • Custom prompt with variables: {TITLE} {KEYWORD} {LSI_KEYWORDS} {LANGUAGE} {SITE_NAME} {YEAR}
  • 4 content languages — Ukrainian, English, Polish, German
  • Dashboard with queue, logs, and statistics

Pro (€19, one-time)

Pro is an optional one-time license for users who want to support continued development. It activates a “Pro” badge in Settings and hides the upgrade prompts in the admin.

Important, honest note: all article-generation and automation features listed above — including CSV import, autopilot scheduling, batch publishing, OG/Twitter meta, and auto-tags — are already included in the free version. Pro does not lock any of them. Buy Pro only if you want to support the project; you are not missing any functionality by staying on free.

Requirements

  • Nothing to start — the first 15 articles are free and need no API key
  • For unlimited generation: an API key from any of the 10 supported providers (several offer a free tier), or a local Ollama server with no key at all
  • Optional, for photos: a free Pexels API key — get one

Коротко українською

NemynAI — це AI-копірайтер і автоблог для WordPress: він сам пише SEO-статті і публікує їх за вас, вручну або на автопілоті. Перші 15 статей безкоштовні, без жодного API-ключа. Далі додайте власний ключ Claude (Anthropic) для необмеженої генерації. Жодного екрана підключення: усі сторінки працюють одразу після активації. Pro (€19 одноразово) — опційна ліцензія для підтримки розробки; усі функції вже доступні у безкоштовній версії.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

NemynAI Free Article Service — provides up to 15 free AI-generated articles per site so new users can start without their own API key. It is used ONLY while you have not entered your own Claude API key; once you add your own key, this service is never contacted.
– Data sent: an anonymous random site identifier (UUID), your site’s domain, the article topic, keyword(s), content language, and your custom prompt (if set). No personal data is sent.
– When: each time you generate an article in free mode (manual or scheduled), and a small quota check when opening the generate/dashboard pages.
– Service URL: https://nemynai.pp.ua/naseo-api
– Privacy Policy: https://nemynai.pp.ua/plugin-demo/privacy/
– Note: this service forwards your topic/keywords to the Anthropic Claude API (below) to produce the text; it never stores the generated article.

Your chosen AI provider — used to generate SEO article content with your own API key. You select ONE provider in Settings; only that provider is contacted, and only when you generate an article (manually or via the autopilot schedule). In every case the only data sent is the article topic, keyword(s), content language, and your custom prompt if set — never personal user data, credentials, or visitor data. Choose from:

Anthropic Claude API
– Service URL: https://api.anthropic.com
– Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
– Terms of Use: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms

OpenAI API

– Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
– Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

Google Gemini API (free tier available)
– Service URL: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
– Terms of Use: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms

Mistral AI API (free tier available)
– Service URL: https://api.mistral.ai
– Privacy Policy: https://mistral.ai/terms#privacy-policy
– Terms of Use: https://mistral.ai/terms#terms-of-use

DeepSeek API
– Service URL: https://api.deepseek.com
– Privacy Policy: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
– Terms of Use: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html

xAI Grok API
– Service URL: https://api.x.ai
– Privacy Policy: https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
– Terms of Use: https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service

Groq API (free tier available)

– Privacy Policy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy
– Terms of Use: https://openrouter.ai/terms

Cohere API (free tier available)

– Privacy Policy: https://cohere.com/privacy
– Terms of Use: https://cohere.com/terms-of-use

Ollama (local) — runs on a server you control (default http://localhost:11434). This is NOT a third-party cloud service: your topic/keywords never leave your own infrastructure, and no API key is used. The only “external” aspect is that you may download model weights to that server yourself.
– Software: https://ollama.com
– API docs: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/api.md

Pexels API — used to fetch royalty-free photos for articles.
– Data sent: search keyword derived from article topic
– Service URL: https://api.pexels.com
– Privacy Policy: https://www.pexels.com/privacy-policy/
– Terms of Use: https://www.pexels.com/terms-of-service/

The chosen AI provider and Pexels require the user to provide their own API key (Ollama needs none) and are only called when the user explicitly triggers article generation or when WP Cron runs the autopublish schedule.

Freemius — used for license management and plugin update delivery for the Pro version.
– Data sent: site URL and license key when activating or validating a Pro license
– Service URL: https://api.freemius.com
– Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
– Terms of Use: https://freemius.com/terms/

This service is only contacted when a user purchases and activates a Pro license. Free users running in anonymous mode are not tracked.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New (or upload the ZIP).
  2. Open NemynAI SEO → Generate. You can create your first article immediately — no key required (15 free articles included).
  3. Fill in a title and keyword, then click Generate & Publish.
  4. Optional: open NemynAI SEO → Settings to add your own Claude API key (for unlimited generation) and a Pexels key (for photos).
  5. Optional: import a CSV content plan and enable the daily autopilot schedule.
sections.faq:
What are the 15 free articles?

Right after activation you can generate up to 15 complete SEO articles with no API key and no account. They are produced through the NemynAI Free Article Service, which forwards your topic to the Claude API and returns the text. A counter (“X of 15 free articles left”) is shown on the Dashboard and the Generate page.

What data is sent to the NemynAI service?

Only while you are in free mode (no own key), each generation sends: an anonymous random site identifier (UUID), your site’s domain, the article topic, keyword(s), the content language, and your custom prompt if you set one. No personal data is sent, and the generated article is never stored. As soon as you add your own Claude key, this service is never contacted again — requests go straight from your site to Anthropic. See the External Services section and our privacy policy: https://nemynai.pp.ua/plugin-demo/privacy/

How do I use my own API key?

Open NemynAI SEO → Settings, choose your AI provider, paste your key (it is stored masked), pick a model, and click Test connection. From then on generation is unlimited and billed by that provider to your own account. The Get API key link next to the field opens the provider’s key page directly. You can optionally add a free Pexels key for photos.

Which AI providers are supported, and which have a free tier?

Ten: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI Grok, Groq, OpenRouter, Cohere, and Ollama (local). Google Gemini, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter and Cohere currently offer a free API tier (shown with a “Free tier available” badge next to the provider). Ollama runs entirely on your own server with no API key and no cloud. The others are paid. See the External Services section for each provider’s endpoint, data sent, and terms/privacy links.

What does Pro give me?

Honestly: no extra features. Every content and automation feature is already free. Pro (€19 one-time) activates a Pro badge and removes the in-admin upgrade prompts — it is a way to support development, not a feature unlock.

Where do I buy Pro?

On the Freemius checkout: https://checkout.freemius.com/plugin/31117/plan/51043/

Does the opt-in / connect screen block the plugin?

No. The plugin runs in anonymous mode by default, so there is no connect wall — every page works immediately after activation. You may opt in later from the account screen, and declining never disables any feature.
sections.changelog:
2.2.0

  • Added: choose from 10 AI providers in the free version — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI Grok, Groq, OpenRouter, Cohere, and local Ollama
  • Added: single provider abstraction (one generate() interface) with per-provider request building and response parsing, verified against each provider’s official API documentation
  • Added: Settings redesigned with a provider dropdown, masked (password) key field, model picker defaulting to an inexpensive current model, a “Test connection” button with human-readable error messages, and a direct “Get API key” link per provider
  • Added: “Free tier available” badge shown only for providers with a confirmed free API tier today (Gemini, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter, Cohere), plus Ollama which runs locally with no key
  • Added: local Ollama support with a Base URL field and no API key required
  • Added: source priority — the selected provider’s own key (or local Ollama) is used first; otherwise the 15 free NemynAI articles (2.1.0 behaviour preserved)
  • Added: each provider documented individually in External Services with its endpoint, data sent, and terms/privacy links
  • Added: new UI strings via __() with a matching Ukrainian translation in /languages
  • Compatibility: sites upgrading from 2.1.0 keep working unchanged — an existing Claude key is reused automatically

2.1.0

  • Renamed: plugin is now “NemynAI – AI Content Writer & Autoblog: Auto-Post SEO Articles” to describe what it actually does
  • Added: 15 free articles with no API key — generated through the NemynAI service right after activation
  • Fixed: non-blocking opt-in — the Freemius connect wall no longer gates the plugin; every page works immediately after activation (anonymous mode by default, no forced opt-in redirect)
  • Added: anonymous site identifier (UUID) created on activation for free-quota tracking
  • Added: “X of 15 free articles left” counter on the Dashboard and Generate pages
  • Added: friendly “limit reached” screen with two paths — add your own Anthropic key, or upgrade to Pro
  • Added: polite, dismissible review request after the 3rd published article (no rewards, no gating)
  • Added: English UI strings via __() plus a Ukrainian translation in /languages
  • Added: NemynAI Free Article Service documented in External Services with its privacy policy
  • Fixed: Pexels API key is now clearly optional — articles publish without photos and show a hint
  • Fixed: raise PHP time limit to 300s during generation to avoid timeouts on shared hosting
  • Fixed: “Buy Pro” now points to the Freemius checkout everywhere (removed the stale Lemon Squeezy link in admin.js)
  • Fixed: consistent single Pro price (€19 one-time) across the UI and readme
  • Clarified: Pro honestly unlocks no extra features — all content/automation features are free

2.0.8

  • Fixed: removed Pro gate from NASEO_Scheduler::run() and run_now() — autopublish now works in Free
  • Fixed: removed Pro gate from NASEO_CSV_Importer::import() — CSV import now works in Free
  • Fixed: renamed $nsa_fs global and nsa_fs() function to $naseo_fs and naseo_fs() for unique prefix compliance
  • Fixed: renamed do_action nsa_fs_loaded to naseo_fs_loaded
  • Added: Freemius documented in readme External Services section
  • Added: alexww added to Contributors list

2.0.7

  • Fixed: CSV import and autopublish available without a Pro license
  • Fixed: “Publish Now” button available to all users
  • Fixed: publish-frequency select no longer locked in Free
  • Removed: Pro gate on the CSV Import page

2.0.6

  • Fixed: JS did not load on plugin pages (wrong hook check)
  • Fixed: the naseo object was not available in JS (wrong name in wp_localize_script)
  • Fixed: “Generate & Publish” button did not respond to clicks

2.0.5

  • Fixed: phpcs:ignore moved inline to $wpdb->update in seo-writer
  • Fixed: class-freemius.php wrapped with phpcs:disable NamingConventions

2.0.4

  • Fixed: Tested up to header corrected to 7.0
  • Fixed: $class variable in foreach prefixed with phpcs:ignore
  • Fixed: NASEO_VERSION constant synced with plugin header
  • Fixed: Remaining DirectQuery/NoCaching annotated with phpcs:ignore
  • Fixed: $wpdb->insert, delete, get_row in class-admin annotated

2.0.3

  • Fixed: unlink() replaced with wp_delete_file()
  • Fixed: readfile() replaced with WP_Filesystem
  • Fixed: date() replaced with gmdate() in scheduler
  • Fixed: SQL queries use esc_sql() instead of %i (WP 6.2+ only)
  • Fixed: $_POST variables wrapped with wp_unslash()
  • Fixed: Direct DB calls annotated with phpcs:ignore
  • Fixed: readme Description translated to English
  • Fixed: Tested up to updated to 7.0
  • Fixed: NonPrefixedVariable warnings suppressed in view files

2.0.2

  • Fixed: text domain changed from naseo to nemynai-seo-autopilot
  • Fixed: all output properly escaped (esc_html_e, esc_url, absint)
  • Fixed: date() replaced with gmdate() for timezone safety
  • Fixed: translators comments added for i18n placeholders
  • Fixed: SQL queries use $wpdb->prepare()
  • Fixed: readme short description in English, tested up to 6.8
  • Fixed: removed Pro upsell buttons from dashboard (free version)
  • Added: External Services section in readme

2.0.0

  • Freemium model: Free + Pro license
  • Domain-bound license
  • Improved admin UI

1.2.1

  • First public release
  • Claude API integration
  • CSV import and WP Cron
